  • Method Details

    • generateInstance

      public static RedisAPI generateInstance(@NonNull @NonNull RedisCredentials credentials)
      Creates a new main Redis pool instance, there will only ever be one at a time so #getInstance should be used after generation
      Parameters:
      credentials - the credentials used to connect to the Redis server running, instanceof api.RedisCredentials
      Returns:
      main instance of the api.RedisAPI
      Throws:
      CouldNotConnectToRedisException - signifies either an issue with the password passed through or the URI that is passed through the method

    • generateInstance

      public static RedisAPI generateInstance(@NonNull @NonNull String uri)
      Creates a new main Redis pool instance, there will only ever be one at a time so #getInstance should be used after generation
      Parameters:
      uri - the URI used to connect to the Redis server running (e.g. redis://username:password@localhost:6379 or redis://localhost:6379)
      Returns:
      main instance of the api.RedisAPI
      Throws:
      CouldNotConnectToRedisException - signifies either an issue with the password passed through or the URI that is passed through the method

    • generateInstance

      public static RedisAPI generateInstance(@NonNull @NonNull String uri, String password)
      Creates a new main Redis pool instance, there will only ever be one at a time so #getInstance should be used after generation
      Parameters:
      uri - the URI used to connect to the Redis server running (e.g. redis://localhost:6379)
      password - the password used to connect to the Redis server running
      Returns:
      main instance of the api.RedisAPI
      Throws:
      CouldNotConnectToRedisException - signifies either an issue with the password passed through or the URI that is passed through the method

    • startListeners

      public void startListeners()
      Starts listeners for the Redis Pub/Sub channels. This creates a single long-lived subscriber connection.

    • shutdown

      public void shutdown()
      Stops the Pub/Sub listener thread (if running), closes the pool, and shuts down the worker pools. Work already queued on the workers is allowed to finish.

    • publishMessage

      public CompletableFuture<Void> publishMessage(RedisChannel channel, String message)
      Asynchronously publishes a message to the generated instances redis pool
      Parameters:
      channel - the channel object being published to, this is what should be registered on your other instances
      message - the message being sent across that channel
      Returns:
      a CompletableFuture<Void> representing the asynchronous operation

    • publishMessage

      public CompletableFuture<Void> publishMessage(String filterId, RedisChannel channel, String message)
      Asynchronously publishes a message to the generated instances redis pool
      Parameters:
      filterId - the filter id for the message being sent, this filter id is checked by all the receiving pools to ensure that only a specific Jedis pool handles the message
      channel - the channel object being published to, this is what should be registered on your other instances
      message - the message being sent across that channel
      Returns:
      a CompletableFuture<Void> representing the asynchronous operation

    • registerChannel

      public RedisChannel registerChannel(String channelName, @NonNull @NonNull Class<? extends RedisMessagingReceiveInterface> receiveEventClass)
      Used to register a redis channel, this must be done before sending any messages on this channel
      Parameters:
      channelName - the name of the channel, this is what is used when publishing a message
      receiveEventClass - the class which extends RedisMessagingReceiveInterface, this is where incoming messages on this channel will be sent
      Returns:
      object of the registered RedisChannel
      Throws:
      ChannelAlreadyRegisteredException - exception is thrown if channel with same name is already registered

    • registerChannel

      public RedisChannel registerChannel(String channelName, @NonNull @NonNull Consumer<RedisMessagingReceiveEvent> receiveEventConsumer)
      Used to register a redis channel, this must be done before sending any messages on this channel
      Parameters:
      channelName - the name of the channel, this is what is used when publishing a message
      receiveEventConsumer - the consumer which has RedisMessagingReceiveEvent, this is where incoming messages on this channel will be sent
      Returns:
      object of the registered RedisChannel
      Throws:
      ChannelAlreadyRegisteredException - exception is thrown if channel with same name is already registered
